rule: One canonical gate set for every Swedish site. A site that has no derivation for a gate gets it OPEN with a reason; a gate is never dropped because a site lacks the receipt that would answer it. Gate ids are stable: aliases map an older or site-local id onto the canonical one so no ledger loses a gate to a rename.
generated_by: hand-authored union of the Svärtinge plot-intelligence set (18) and the generic ledger generator's set (11), 2026-09-20

gates.question: Which municipality decides here, and is that established from an official source?

requires_pattern.means: Lantmäteriet publishes fastighetsindelning per kommun, so the kn code in the product this parcel was clipped from names the kommun whose register the parcel sits in. That is authoritative.

closes_when.still_not_established: The kommun's NAME here comes from geocoding, which is REPORTED; the authoritative part is the kommun CODE.

gates.note: Closed by the kommun code in the authoritative property-division product, never by a geocoder's kommun name alone. DEPENDENCY: requires_pattern reads source_product, so this rule is only as good as how that string was written. A receipt ingested before the archive-read fix (repo-spatial-studio fdae4ea938) carries a COMPOSED product name and could in principle answer jurisdiction from a label rather than from the archive. Re-ingest a site before trusting this gate on an older receipt.

gates.question: Does the address resolve to a named registered parcel, with its registered extent confirmed by an authoritative source?

closes_when.still_not_established: Title and ownership are not established by a property-division clip; that is GATE_SE_PROPERTY_REGISTER.

gates.question: Has an authoritative property-division vector been acquired for this parcel and its neighbours?
Has a property-register extract (title, area of record, encumbrances) been obtained?
What servitudes, rights and joint facilities burden or benefit this parcel?
Is there a field survey or boundary determination good enough to set a building out against?
gates.note: Registered property-division geometry does NOT close this. It is authoritative for extent, not for monument positions.

gates.question: Is there a detaljplan covering this parcel, and what is its status?
Which national rule profile is in force for this assessment?
Is this parcel eligible under the H30/H50 conditional rules?
What setback, footprint, ridge height and placement may actually be built?
Is a receipted height model clipped to this parcel, with deterministic derivations?
Was the height model checked against the source epoch for this parcel?
What are the soil and bedrock conditions under this parcel, from investigation rather than screening?
Is this parcel exposed to flooding, landslide or erosion?
Are the official building footprints on and around this parcel acquired?
Are the heights of existing buildings established, rather than assumed?
What environmental protections apply across this parcel?
Where does the shoreline run, and how much of the parcel falls inside the strandskydd band?
Is an extended strandskydd (utvidgat) in force here?
Has a strandskydd dispens been granted for what is proposed?
Are there heritage or contamination constraints on this parcel?
Is open water visible from this parcel, computed from the height model?
Do vegetation and buildings occlude that view in practice?
Is there a legally secured access route to this parcel?
Are water, sewer, power and data available with capacity to connect?
Is there clearance to build — permits, notifications and start authorisation?
Does the measured fall satisfy the designer's stated condition for the conditional souterrain?
gates.note: The threshold is NOT typed here. It is parsed from the designer's own condition text and compared against a measurement from the height receipt, so if the designer changes the condition the gate follows, and if the text stops parsing the gate fails loudly rather than quietly keeping a stale number.

measurement_from.label: fall across the parcel (1 m DTM)
